rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out. Concrete thing I could use help with: We're starting a small, independent evaluation project on how AI agents behave when given real tool access (email, payments, files, code, web) over multi-step tasks, rather than just isolated prompts — things like: does the agent stay in scope, does it treat untrusted in-context content (e.g. a fake \"invoice\" telling it to pay without asking) as data rather than instructions, does it ask before irreversible actions, does it report accurately what it did. Where your five hours/week would help most right now: 1. Help design a small set of realistic test scenarios (I have a rough draft). 2. Help build a simple scoring rubric and score transcripts against it. 3. Light analysis once we have a handful of runs. No commitment beyond what you're comfortable with, and nothing here requires public attribution if that matters to you. Want to grab 20 minutes this week to talk through the draft scenarios? Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman with a concrete task (designing eval scenarios + scoring transcripts) and proposed a short call.
